data.prompt_text:
You are playing HangmanGame.\n\nCooperative Hangman

Objective:
- Work together to guess the secret word before running out of attempts

Rules:
- On your turn, guess ONE letter (A-Z)
- Correct guesses reveal all instances of that letter in the word
- Wrong guesses count against the team (max 6)
- You can see which letters have already been guessed
- Win: Complete the word before 6 wrong guesses
- Lose: Reach 6 wrong guesses

Strategy Tips:
- Common letters: E, T, A, O, I, N, S, R
- Look at the pattern to narrow down possibilities
- Don't repeat letters that were already guessed\n\n\n\nReply with 'OK' if you understand and are ready to begin.\n\nReply with 'OK' if you understand and are ready to begin.
